calls.statement: SELECT tier, is_current, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), max(valid_to) FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH per AS (
 SELECT member_id, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cur, sum(CASE WHEN valid_to='9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) open_ended, count(DISTINCT member_key) k
 FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'multi_current' chk, count(*) FROM per WHERE cur<>1
UNION ALL SELECT 'multi_open', count(*) FROM per WHERE open_ended<>1
UNION ALL SELECT 'cur_ne_open', count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current <> (valid_to='9999-12-31')
UNION ALL SELECT 'overlap', count(*) FROM dim_member a JOIN dim_member b ON a.member_id=b.member_id AND a.member_key<b.member_key AND a.valid_from<=b.valid_to AND b.valid_from<=a.valid_to
UNION ALL SELECT 'gold_asof_20261008', count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND DATE '2026-10-08' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to
UNION ALL SELECT 'gold_current_by_asof_differs', count(*) FROM dim_member c WHERE c.is_current AND c.tier='Gold' AND NOT (DATE '2026-10-08' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to)
UNION ALL SELECT 'future_valid_from', count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from > DATE '2026-10-08'
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_rows', count(*) FROM stg_member_updates
